protectedFiles.name: ai-connection.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Settings → Privacy & Permissions → Erase all credentials, or disconnect the AI provider.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke or regenerate the key in the provider account when global invalidation is required.

protectedFiles.name: writing-assistant-profiles.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Remove the profile or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke or regenerate the key at its provider.

protectedFiles.name: media-routing.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Remove the media profile or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke or regenerate any cloud-provider key at its provider.

protectedFiles.name: github-app-authorization.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Disconnect GitHub or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke the PlotPickle GitHub App authorization in GitHub for global invalidation.

protectedFiles.name: github-app-pending.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Cancel or complete sign-in; disconnect GitHub or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Pending codes expire; revoke the app authorization in GitHub if authorization completed.

protectedFiles.name: github-connection.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Disconnect GitHub or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke the GitHub App or fine-grained token in GitHub.

protectedFiles.name: github-project-sync.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Disconnect the story repository or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Remove repository access in GitHub when access must end remotely.

protectedFiles.name: collaboration-invitation.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Leave the collaboration workspace or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Revoke repository or provider invitation access when applicable.

protectedFiles.name: google-connection.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Use Disconnect and revoke, or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: PlotPickle requests Google revocation on disconnect; also remove access in the Google account when confirmation is required.

protectedFiles.name: google-pending.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Automatically removed by current Google authorization flows or by erasing all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: No remote action is normally required for an uncompleted pending authorization.

protectedFiles.name: buzz-connection.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Disconnect Buzz or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Remove or rotate the Buzz identity/community access outside PlotPickle when global invalidation is required.

protectedFiles.name: buzz-managed-secrets.json
protectedFiles.localRemoval: Remove the managed Buzz runtime or erase all local credentials.
protectedFiles.remoteRevocation: Not applicable to a local-only runtime unless its credentials were reused elsewhere; rotate them by reinstalling the runtime.

transientFiles.rule: May exist only during one Docker Compose command, must be mode 0600 where supported, and must be deleted in a finally block.
